title: Why Read a Research Paper When You Can Turn It Into an AI Agent?
entities: Research Paper When You Can Turn It Into
summary: Have you ever read a paper in Science or Nature and thought, “Man, that research was so cool. I wish I could try that method on my own data,” only to spend a week wrestling with someone else’s undocumented repo, broken dependencies, and half-finished readme.txt?Well, now you can, more or less.Say hello to Paper2Agent, a new open-source framework that transforms academic reports into interactive AI agents you can talk to.
